name: Greater Manchester Chamber of Commerce
what: The designated Employer Representative Body that wrote the Greater Manchester LSIP, working jointly with GMCA.
why_contact: This is the organisation that asked hundreds of GM employers what skills they need, and wrote this plan.

name: Greater Manchester Combined Authority
what: The strategic authority for Greater Manchester's ten boroughs, responsible for the Greater Manchester Strategy and skills funding.
why_contact: They decide how a lot of GM's skills funding is spent, guided by what this plan says employers need.

name: GM Business Growth Hub
what: Greater Manchester's publicly funded business support service, helping companies grow and invest in their staff.
why_contact: If you're curious how local businesses get help to grow and train staff, this is where they turn.

name: GMACS (Greater Manchester Apprenticeship & Careers Service)
what: GM's careers website for young people, covering apprenticeships, T Levels and other post-16 options.
why_contact: Use this to explore apprenticeships and courses linked to GM's priority sectors, all in one place.

name: University of Manchester
what: A leading research university with strengths across engineering, science, health and digital subjects.
why_contact: Worth a look if you want a big-name university close to home with strong links to GM employers.

name: Manchester Metropolitan University
what: A large university in central Manchester offering degrees and degree apprenticeships across many sectors, including digital, creative and engineering.
why_contact: They run degree apprenticeships that let you earn while you learn in GM priority sectors.

name: The Manchester College (LTE Group)
what: Greater Manchester's largest further education college, offering A levels, T Levels and apprenticeships across construction, digital, health and more.
why_contact: A good first stop for A levels, T Levels or apprenticeships in GM's priority sectors.

name: Greater Manchester Digital Security Hub (DiSH)
what: A cyber security hub bringing together employers, universities and government to grow GM's digital security sector and skills.
why_contact: If cyber security interests you, this is where GM employers go to find and train talent.
